nights.title: dArtagnan
nights.name: DArtagnan
nights.extract: dArtagnan is a German folk rock band from Nuremberg. The band's name makes reference to 17th century French soldier Charles de Batz de Castelmore d'Artagnan, made famous by the author Alexandre Dumas in his d'Artagnan Romances, notably in the novel The Three Musketeers.

en.who: dArtagnan is a German folk rock band from Nuremberg. The band's name makes reference to 17th century French soldier Charles de Batz de Castelmore d'Artagnan, made famous by the author Alexandre Dumas in his d'Artagnan Romances, notably in the novel The Three Musketeers.
facts: The band's name makes reference to 17th century French soldier Charles de Batz de Castelmore d'Artagnan.

Jahrhunderts Charles de Batz de Castelmore d'Artagnan, der durch den Autor Alexandre Dumas in seinen d'Artagnan-Romanen berühmt wurde, vor allem im Roman Die drei Musketiere.

nights.title: Polyphia - BE NOT AFRAID World Tour
nights.name: Polyphia
nights.extract: Polyphia is an American rock band based in Plano, Texas, formed in 2010. The group consists of guitarists Tim Henson and Scott LePage, bassist Clay Gober, and drummer Clay Aeschliman. Rooted in a heavy metal sound in their early releases, the band's music evolved into a more progressive rock style in their later productions, combining elements of electronic and hip-hop music. Polyphia has released five studio albums, one live record, two EPs, and numerous singles.

en.who: Polyphia is an American rock band based in Plano, Texas, formed in 2010. The group consists of guitarists Tim Henson and Scott LePage, bassist Clay Gober, and drummer Clay Aeschliman.
facts: Rooted in a heavy metal sound in their early releases, the band's music evolved into a more progressive rock style in their later productions.

facts: Die Band kam aus einem Heavy-Metal-Sound, entwickelte sich in späteren Veröffentlichungen aber zu einem progressiveren Rockstil.
Polyphia hat fünf Studioalben, ein Livealbum, zwei EPs und zahlreiche Singles veröffentlicht.

tr.who: Polyphia, Texas'ın Plano kentinde merkezli, 2010 yılında kurulmuş bir Amerikalı rock grubudur. Grup; gitaristler Tim Henson ve Scott LePage, basçı Clay Gober ve davulcu Clay Aeschliman'dan oluşuyor.

nights.title: Keimzeit. - Die Tour zum neuen Album
nights.name: Keimzeit
nights.extract: Keimzeit is a German musical band formed in 1979 in Lütte (Belzig) near Potsdam, GDR. Originally called Jogger, they changed their name to Keimzeit in 1982.

nights.title: Amorphis - Borderlands Tour 2027
nights.name: Amorphis
nights.extract: Amorphis is a Finnish progressive metal band founded by Jan Rechberger, Tomi Koivusaari, and Esa Holopainen in 1990. Initially, the band was a death metal act, but on later albums they evolved into playing other genres, including progressive metal, folk metal, and melodic death metal. They frequently use the Kalevala, the epic poem of Finland, as a source for their lyrics.

On later albums they evolved into playing other genres, including progressive metal, folk metal, and melodic death metal.

facts: Anfangs war die Band eine Death-Metal-Gruppe.
Auf späteren Alben spielten sie andere Genres, darunter Progressive Metal, Folk Metal und Melodic Death Metal.
